verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Beijing's Embassy District, set along the Liangma River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bvlgari Hotel Beijing is an urban oasis of tranquillity in the Embassy District, set along the Liangma River where art and nature meet.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is housed within the Genesis Beijing, beside the Genesis Art Gallery designed by Tadao Ando.
verified_facts.excerpt: Housed within the Genesis Beijing, the hotel stands beside the Genesis Art Gallery designed by Tadao Ando

verified_facts.text: The riverside gardens are curated by Swiss landscape architect Enzo Enea.
verified_facts.excerpt: its lush riverside gardens are curated by Swiss landscape architect Enzo Enea

verified_facts.text: ACPV ARCHITECTS Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel was responsible for the entire interior and exterior design.
verified_facts.excerpt: ACPV ARCHITECTS Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel was responsible for the entire interior and exterior design.

verified_facts.excerpt: a 25-metre mosaic-tiled pool inspired by the ancient Terme di Caracalla

verified_facts.text: The spa occupies two floors and features treatments blended with traditional Chinese techniques.

verified_facts.text: The spa has steam and sauna facilities.
The gym has Technogym and Kinesis equipment, with an adjacent movement studio and Pilates.

verified_facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito has custom-designed Barovier & Toso glass chandeliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: custom-designed Barovier & Toso glass chandeliers and chairs and columns wrapped in dark-brown leather

verified_facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito was awarded one Michelin star by The Michelin Guide Beijing for six consecutive years since 2020.
verified_facts.excerpt: Il Ristorante – Niko Romito was awarded one Michelin star by The Michelin Guide Beijing for 6 consecutive years since 2020.

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Bar serves cocktails, fine wine and champagne during Aperitivo Hour at the oval bar or on the outdoor terrace overlooking the riverside.

verified_facts.excerpt: The Chef developed the menus and personally trained each of the chefs that helm Il Ristorante - Niko Romito restaurants around the world.

verified_facts.text: The gym is open 24 hours a day for hotel guests.
